description: Maintained allowlist of vetted stem-separation upstream projects used by the model-proposal bot (issue #266). Each project contributes its GitHub repo (stars/maintenance signal) and optional HuggingFace weight repos to scan.

projects.name: Demucs
projects.notes: Meta hybrid-transformer separation model; official 4/6-stem weights. Already in the Stemgen catalog (htdemucs family).

projects.name: BS-RoFormer
projects.notes: KitsAI band-split RoFormer architecture; community-hosted 4-stem weights. Architecture already supported (bs_roformer).

projects.name: MDX-Net
projects.notes: MDX-Net / UVR-MDX-Net research baseline used across the UVR ecosystem.

projects.name: Open-Unmix
projects.notes: SigSep open-source music separator; official pre-trained weights.

projects.name: UVR
projects.notes: Ultimate Vocal Remover ecosystem (MDX-Net, Demucs and VR models); weights are hosted across many community HF repos.
